page.notes: Several Greek words are uncertain and are not marked [?] in the text: προβλήματος, ἔκθεσις, ἐπιμέλεια, ἀπηγήσει, διάλεξιν, κατασκευή, ἀπαριθμήσεις. The margin notes "Materia di-" and "Imitatio di-" are split across lines and their hyphenated continuations ("sputas. epist.") are partly illegible in the scan. Some Greek is blurred. Running head rendered with u for V in capitals; page number and text otherwise as printed.
